# Animal Humane Society

> Animal Humane Society is a Minnesota-based nonprofit dedicated to animal rescue, shelter services, and veterinary care.

AHS operates as a leading animal welfare organization providing rescue services, shelter operations, and medical care for animals in need. The organization relies on donations and community support to fund its mission.

## Key Topics

- Animal Humane Society (AHS)
- Animal rescue
- Animal shelter
- Veterinary care
